news.title: IU School of Education welcomes new faculty
news.summary_en: A new school year brings new expertise to the IU School of Education faculty. With research interests that include language development in early childhood, gender-inclusive pedagogy, and higher education finance, these scholars and educators will enrich our teaching and research.

news.title: Indiana educators build global connections in the Galápagos
news.summary_en: Ten Indiana teachers had their own summer adventure this July with a trip to the Galápagos Islands as part of a new environmental education initiative. The project provided the opportunity to work alongside faculty from the Universidad San Francisco de Quito and K-12 teachers from the Tomás de Berlanga School on Santa Cruz Island, Galápagos.
